{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''1994 Ohio Secretary of State election''' was held on November 8, 1994, to elect the [[Ohio Secretary of State]]. Primaries were held on May 3, 1994. Incumbent Republican Ohio Secretary of State [[Bob Taft]] won re-election in a landslide, defeating Democratic [[Cleveland City Council]] member [[Dan Brady (Ohio politician)|Dan Brady]] by a nearly two-to-one margin.

== Republican primary ==
=== Candidates ===
*[[Bob Taft]], incumbent [[Ohio Secretary of State]] (1991–1999)
=== Campaign ===
Taft won renomination unopposed.
